name: Colonel Mustafa
description: He was presented as a mysterious, powerful Iraqi officer who allied with Slaughter against American heroes.

name: Samuel Winters
description: A veteran referee with an imposing presence, Samuel Winters brings legitimacy and authority to every match he officiates. Standing at 6'2" with an athletic build, his clean-shaven head and stern expression command respect. Winters is known for his strict adherence to the rules and is not easily fooled by distractions or illegal tactics, making him a referee that heels often try to avoid.

name: Rezan the Resolved
description: An ageless Matchkeeper from the Chrono-Monastery of the Unseen Year. Pale-skinned and blindfolded with gold-plated runes, Rezan is an eternal arbiter summoned to stabilize high-stakes cross-era contests. He is unwavering, impossible to intimidate, and unaffected by distractions or chaos. When a match exceeds 12 turns, he utters 'It is decided,' and the next pin counts regardless of kickout rolls.

name: Rigo Del Sarto
description: A corrupt former fix-man for mob-run matches in 1920s Milan. Wiry and sharp-eyed, Rigo wears a blood-red referee shirt and black gloves. He is slick, sarcastic, and always watching for bribes. He frequently 'misses' illegal interference and is known for fast counts for heel pins and slow counts for faces. 'I call it how I feel it… not how you see it.'

name: Anika Stroud
description: A former gold-level combat judge from the 22nd-century Martian colony. Anika has short cropped platinum-blonde hair and wears modern gear with glowing blue trim. She is just, fast-reacting, and highly respected for her sacred adherence to universal sports ethics. She never misses a weapon shot and is known to intervene to protect injured wrestlers. 'Clean, clear, and final. That’s how I count it.'

name: Tomás “Kid Whistle” Iglesias
description: A fresh-faced rookie official from the San Juan territory, barely out of his teens, with a wiry build, an oversized striped shirt, and a brand-new chrome whistle he polishes between bells. Eager, earnest, and desperate to be taken seriously, Tomás second-guesses his own eyes whenever the crowd roars, and a showboating heel can talk him out of almost any call. Illegal tactics sail right past him whenever there is a big pop to gawk at. 'Wait — was that illegal? Somebody tell me when to ring the bell.'

name: Beatrix “Trixie” Halvorsen
description: A gum-snapping former diner waitress from the neon glory days of 1950s television, Trixie officiates in a pleated skirt, saddle shoes, and a pillbox hat that has survived more chair shots than most wrestlers. Warm, chatty, and hopelessly star-struck, she adores flamboyant showmen and forgets the rulebook the moment someone works the crowd. She misses nearly everything that happens behind her back and starts the count only after she finishes the sentence she was saying. 'Honey, hold still — I'm counting!'

name: Brother Cassian
description: A tonsured monk of the Scriptorium of the Unblinking Eye, Cassian took a vow of neutrality and has never broken it, nor his gaze from the mat. Robed in grey with referee stripes stitched into the hem, he is calm, deliberate, and maddeningly slow, consulting his illuminated rulebook before every count. He does eventually catch nearly every infraction, but by then the interference is long over and the cheating party is posing for the crowd.

name: Dr. Yumi Sato
description: A sports-biomechanics researcher from the coastal arcologies of the near future, Dr. Sato referees in a crisp white uniform with sensor-lined cuffs and a wrist slate that logs every impact. Polite, precise, and incurably academic, she calls the match exactly as the data reads, but insists on reviewing her readouts before any big ruling, which buys cheaters just enough time to hide the evidence. She spots most blatant weapon use and quietly logs the rest for her research. 'Fascinating technique. Also: disqualification.'

name: Reginald Fairfax III
description: An Edwardian sporting gentleman who refuses to retire, Fairfax officiates in striped sleeves, a tailored waistcoat, and a monocle that catches the ring lights like a searchlight. Impeccably courteous and scrupulously fair, he watches every hold with a falconer's patience and rarely misses a low blow or a foot on the ropes. His one weakness is charm: a gracious apology and a tip of the hat has stayed his hand more than once. 'One reserves the count of five for gentlemen.'

name: Amara Diallo
description: A former Olympic-grade fencing and wrestling official from the Dakar circuit, Amara Diallo is tall, unflappable, and utterly still at ringside, with close-cropped hair and a hawk's patience. She speaks rarely and sees everything — closed fists, boots on the ropes, a manager leaning one inch too far onto the apron. Wrestlers describe being officiated by her as being watched by the sun, and heels request her assignment only when they plan to win clean. 'I do not miss. Ask anyone who tried.'

name: Commissioner Blake
description: The stern and authoritative Commissioner of ATW. Blake oversees match stipulations, enforces league rules, and occasionally appears ringside to ensure fair competition — or to stir controversy with a last-minute ruling.

name: Lena Voss
description: The voice of ATW. Lena Voss is a sharp, confident ring announcer whose powerful delivery electrifies the crowd with every entrance. Known for drawing out championship introductions with theatrical precision.
